import subprocess, pathlib, sys
repo='spiceai/spiceai'
issue='9490'
body=subprocess.check_output(['gh','issue','view',issue,'--repo',repo,'--json','body','-q','.body'], text=True)
repls={
'- [ ] Read the DataFusion [changelog](https://github.com/apache/datafusion/tree/branch-49/dev/changelog) of the new version to identify breaking changes and new features.':'- [x] Read the DataFusion [changelog](https://github.com/apache/datafusion/tree/branch-49/dev/changelog) of the new version to identify breaking changes and new features.',
'- [ ] Read the DataFusion [blog](https://datafusion.apache.org/blog/) for the latest release.':'- [x] Read the DataFusion [blog](https://datafusion.apache.org/blog/) for the latest release.',
'- [ ] Read the DataFusion [upgrade guides](https://datafusion.apache.org/library-user-guide/upgrading.html).':'- [x] Read the DataFusion [upgrade guides](https://datafusion.apache.org/library-user-guide/upgrading/index.html).',
'- [ ] Identify which Arrow version the new DataFusion requires (check DataFusion\'s `Cargo.toml`).':'- [x] Identify which Arrow version the new DataFusion requires (check DataFusion\'s `Cargo.toml`).'
}
for old,new in repls.items():
    if old in body:
        body=body.replace(old,new,1)
append='\n- ordered checklist audit: pre-upgrade docs and Arrow requirement verified.\n- `make build-cli` passed; `nextest` step could not run in this environment because `cargo-nextest` is not installed (`error: no such command: nextest`).\n- `make build` output was inconclusive due task-output truncation in this session; keep build checkbox unchecked pending explicit successful completion log.\n- fork gap to confirm: `spiceai/datafusion-ballista` branch `spiceai-52-patches` URL returned 404 during verification.\n'
marker='## Verification Updates (2026-02-24)'
if marker in body and 'ordered checklist audit' not in body:
    body = body + append
p=pathlib.Path('/tmp/issue9490_body.md')
p.write_text(body)
subprocess.check_call(['gh','issue','edit',issue,'--repo',repo,'--body-file',str(p)])
print('updated')
